name: ProsperoStore
description: Native app store for PS5 homebrew: browse this catalog, install apps and keep them up to date.
author: BlackBearReloaded
release_notes:
Updates no longer delete your files. Still an alpha version: please report problems.
- When the store updates an app, the previous folder is now kept, with anything you had put inside it, in /data/prosperostore/previous/<TITLE ID> (or prosperostore/previous on the app's drive). It stays until that app's next update. Before, an update replaced the app's folder and files added inside it were lost.
- The update message tells you where the previous folder is. Move your files back by FTP if you need them.
- The release ZIP now stores every file as 777, for tools that keep a ZIP's permissions. If the console still says it can't start the app (CE-107750-0) after you copy the folder, see the note under Install in the README.

Tip: keep your own files outside the app's folder when the app allows it.
